operations.title: Position both rear panels
operations.title_ja: 上下の後パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the rear panel clips
operations.title_ja: 後パネルのクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the rear clip fasteners
operations.title_ja: 後クリップの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

operations.title: Position both lower top-hat hinges
operations.title_ja: トップハットの下ヒンジを合わせる
operations.note: The lower top-hat hinges belong on the rear. Align them with the upper hinges at the later attachment step.

operations.title: Check the lower hinge fasteners
operations.title_ja: 下ヒンジの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: The lower top-hat hinges belong on the rear. Align them with the upper hinges at the later attachment step.

operations.title: Position the right side panel
operations.title_ja: 右の透明パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the right panel and hinge clips
operations.title_ja: 右側のクリップとヒンジ受けを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the right panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: 右パネルの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

operations.title: Position the left side panel
operations.title_ja: 左の透明パネルを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Fit the left panel clips
operations.title_ja: 左側のクリップを合わせる
operations.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

operations.title: Check the left panel fasteners
operations.title_ja: 左パネルの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

operations.title: Prepare the door and its four clips
operations.title_ja: ドアと4個のクリップを準備
operations.note: Attach the four original door clips to the door with VHB tape. Leave the hinge pins for the next step.

operations.title: Fit the upper and lower door pins
operations.title_ja: ドアの上下ヒンジ軸を確認
operations.note: Use the upper M3x40 and lower M3x30 hinge pins shown in the official diagram.

operations.title: Check the lift-off door direction
operations.title_ja: ドアを上へ抜く向きを確認
operations.note: Check that the door lifts upward off its right-side hinges. An insertion or removal path is not simulated.

operations.title: Prepare both latches and their magnets
operations.title_ja: ラッチ2個と磁石を準備
operations.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

operations.title: Check the latch fasteners
operations.title_ja: ラッチの固定ねじを確認
operations.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

operations.title: Prepare the handle and matching magnets
operations.title_ja: ハンドルと対応する磁石を準備
operations.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

operations.title: Position the handle on the door
operations.title_ja: ドアにハンドルを合わせる
operations.note: Attach the original handle to the door with VHB tape after checking the matching magnets.

operations.title: Check the handle and latch magnets
operations.title_ja: ハンドルとラッチの磁石を確認
operations.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

operations.title: Source CAD: check the two lock studs
operations.title_ja: 元CADのロック用ねじ2本を確認
operations.note: The source has M3x8 studs; the manual specifies M3x10. Check the 5 mm reference separately from screw length.

operations.title: Source CAD: retain the two hinge washers
operations.title_ja: 元CADのヒンジワッシャー2枚を確認
operations.note: These two washers are retained from the source CAD. Show them with the hinge pins; they are not an added manual BOM item.

operations.title: Fit both top-hat hinge pins
operations.title_ja: トップハットのヒンジ軸2本を確認
operations.note: Source CAD placement reference. Insertion paths, tightening and physical fit remain unverified.
